nom: Clinique All About Clean Rinse-Off Foaming Face Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily and combination-oily skin, including some managing hormonal or cystic acne, report the cleanser controls excess oil and calms breakouts without over-drying.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are notably split: many, including some who specifically push back on the 'for oily skin' label, report it is gentle and non-stripping, while others, including two of the lowest-rated reviews, report it left their skin tight, rashy, or excessively dry.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, spanning combo-oily and combo-dry, report a fresh, balanced feel and effective makeup and oil removal without irritation.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with chemical, dye, or acrylate sensitivities, consistently report no irritation or reaction and describe it as gentle enough for daily use.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who describes her skin as mature reports no residue and no tightness after rinsing.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including many with dry or sensitive skin, report the cleanser does not strip or dry the skin and leaves it feeling soft rather than tight. A real minority, however, including some of the lowest-rated reviews, report significant dryness or tightness, with a few saying outright it is not suited to dry skin despite Clinique now marketing it for all skin types.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation or reaction, including some with known chemical or product sensitivities. A minority, however, report stinging or burning, particularly around the eyes or mucous membranes, and one reviewer developed a facial rash that lasted a week.
concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers with acne-prone skin, including some managing cystic or hormonal breakouts, report calmer skin and fewer breakouts with regular use. One reviewer, however, reports the cleanser caused new acne on her chin on two separate occasions.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser controls excess oil through the day without over-drying; no reviewer in this set reports it making their skin oilier.

aspects.libelle: Weaker foam than the discontinued original
Small amount goes a long way
Can leave a slight residue or film

extraits.titre: For oily skin - not dry or combination-dry
extraits.texte: I purchased this product thinking it was "Clinique Rinse Off Foaming Cleanser", a gentle mousse cleanser that Clinique includes in its sample packages. I was expecting a gentle cleanser similar to the "facial soap - mild" cleansing bar Clinique used to make for skin types 1 and 2. I used it once and learned that it is definitely not intended for dry skin - I had a rash on my face for a week! I'm a long-time user of Clinique products (44 years), but I've never experienced this sort of product mis-match before, especially one so costly and with no recourse.

I've tried this for a few days on two separate occasions and both times it caused significant acne on my chin. That's not even a normal breakout zone for me. I thought it could be something else the first time but after stopping, my face clearing up for a few weeks, and trying it again BOOM. Fool me once. The texture feels nice and you don't need much to cover your entire face. It smells like oatmeal in the most medicinal way.

My favorite Clinique product! The reason I feel compelled to write a review is that I keep reading how this product is for oily skin. Well, this dry-skinned mama LOVES the smoothness, the easy rinsing, and the way my skin feels so fresh and supple after use, never taut or dry. My skin loves this stuff! In fact, I may stock up, since Clinique seems to be discontinuing lots of good products, recently! Kidding/Not kidding...

I have always had oily/combination skin and have struggled with acne my entire life, since going into perimenopause my skin became very oily and I was getting bad cystic acne on the bottom half of my face. I've tried so many skincare products(have probably tried most of the stuff in Ulta haha), I also cannot use anything with salicylic acid because it breaks me out worse. I found this controls the oil and have been using it consistently for about 10 months now and I only get a pimple every now and then. I do also use the clinique toner(one in the pink bottle) and a few other face washes alongside it, but I always start and finish with this one! if I do have a breakout, I use panoxyl(only on breakout area). I also use la roche posay and cosrx skincare products. If my skin is dry I make sure I follow up with clinique moisture surge moisturizer. I also use the clinique all about clean cleansing and exfoliating wash once a week. I love clinique skincare products! I introduced this to my best friend and it also works for her skin as well!

I have very sensitive skin- allergic to most chemicals, dyes, even the sun. This is the one product that works no matter what my skin is going through. Soothing, gentle cleanser that actually does get makeup off.

The rinse is very important to me, and this one is the best! I have mature skin, not really oily, and there is absolutely NO residue feeling left - doesn't leave my skin tight either. I've used the liquid facial soap extra mild and it isn't half as good as this cleanser. Please, KEEP IT AROUND. Thank you!
